name: event
description: An academic event (nfdi:NFDI_0010020, conference) is an occurrent located in time with obo:BFO_0000199, with organisers and audience attached as participants via obo:RO_0000057 and headcount as an input via obo:RO_0002233. Recurrence and title are separate value nodes.
competency_questions: Which academic events has NFDI-MatWerk organised, and when?; Which organisation or task area organised a given event, and how often does it recur?; Which publications or educational materials came out of a given event?
